description.sv: En resurssnål wallpaper-daemon för Wayland, skriven i Go. Kommunicerar direkt med en Wayland-server via delat minne (SHM), med handskriven protokollhantering baserad på Waylands XML-specifikationer, ingen kodgenerator använd.
description.en: A resource-efficient wallpaper daemon for Wayland, written in Go. Communicates directly with a Wayland-server using shared memory (SHM), with handwritten protocol handling based on the Wayland XML specifications, no code generator used.
